headline: CBN abolishes dual FX market: flexible inter-bank regime, single market structure, naira floats from June 20
outcome_text: managed float replaces peg; naira fell ~22% on open
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: Emefiele press briefing + guidelines 2016-06-15 (Channels TV full text, ThisDay same-day); inter-bank trading began 2016-06-20 (Brookings). Long-duration FX regime catalyst.

headline: CBN restricts bank dividend payout by CAR/NPL/composite-risk thresholds (BSD/DIR/GEN/LAB/11/002)
outcome_text: payout capped or barred for weak CAR/NPL banks
notes: Verified 2026-07-16 against CBN letter PDF (primary, dated Jan 31 2018); secondary Mondaq/BusinessPost. NPL>10% or sub-min CAR = no dividend; 5-10% NPL = max 30% payout.

headline: NAICOM raises insurer minimum paid-up capital: life 2->8bn, general 3->10bn, composite 5->18bn, reinsurance 10->20bn (NAICOM/DPR/CIR/25/2019)
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: circular dated 2019-05-20 (Aluko & Oyebode client alert; BrandSpur 2019-06-03). Dilution risk for listed insurers -> structurally_impairing=1. Multi-year catalyst; later extended, segmented, and court-suspended.

headline: CBN imposes minimum 60% loan-to-deposit ratio on banks; shortfall penalised via 50% CRR levy
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: directive dated 2019-07-03 (Nairametrics same-day; BusinessDay analysis). Forced credit expansion - margin/risk effects on banks are the research question.

headline: CBN raises minimum loan-to-deposit ratio to 65% (supplement to July circular)
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: supplement dated 2019-09-30 (Mondaq review; TheCable). Dec 2019: CBN debited banks N650bn for shortfalls (Vanguard) - enforcement was real.

headline: NAICOM extends insurance recapitalisation deadline to 2020-12-31 (NAICOM/DPR/CIR/25-03/2019)
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: extension circular dated 2019-12-30 (Aluko & Oyebode; MFW4A).

headline: NAICOM segments recapitalisation into two phases: 50% by end-2020, full compliance by Sep 2021 (NAICOM/DPR/CIR/25-Q4/2020)
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: segmentation circular dated 2020-06-03 (Alliance Law Firm review). NOTE known gap: exact date of the Dec-2020 court-ordered suspension circular not yet verified - suit FHC/L/CS/1797/2020 filed 2020-12-15; suspension event NOT entered pending primary date.

headline: CBN ends weekly FX sales to Bureau De Change operators (~5,500 BDCs, ~$110m/week), channels retail FX to banks
outcome_text: BDC segment cut off from official FX
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: announced at MPC briefing 2021-07-27 (Channels, DailyPost same-day). Widened official-parallel spread era.

headline: Petroleum Industry Act signed into law: new legal/fiscal/governance framework for oil & gas after two decades of stalled reform
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: signed 2021-08-16 (Punch breaking; PETAN; Senate passed 2021-07-15). Multi-year structural catalyst for NGXOILGAS.

headline: 'Fuel subsidy is gone' - petrol subsidy removal declared in presidential inauguration speech; pump prices repriced within days
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: declared 2023-05-29 (Channels same-day). Two weeks before the 2023-06-14 FX unification (already in DB) - the two 2023 shocks bracket the regime change.

headline: CBN bars banks from paying dividends or opex from FX revaluation gains; gains to be held as counter-cyclical buffer (BSD/DIR/CON/LAB/16/020)
notes: Verified 2026-07-16: circular dated 2023-09-11, ref BSD/DIR/CON/LAB/16/020, signed Haruna Mustafa (TheCable/Punch/Vanguard Sep 2023). Directly interacts with the 2024 recapitalisation (banks sitting on FX gains they cannot count).
